# cycle_hub_members (Data Source)

Retrieves all members of the current Cycle hub, with their account email and assigned role (`/v1/hubs/current/members`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every member of the current hub with their account email and role.
data "cycle_hub_members" "all" {}

output "member_emails" {
  value = [for member in data.cycle_hub_members.all.members : member.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The list of hub members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The ID of the member's Cycle account.
- `email` (String) The email address of the member's account.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the hub membership.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the hub role assigned to this member.
- `state` (String) The current state of the membership (e.g. `accepted`).
